title: Battle of Roncesvalles (1813)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Roncesvalles (1813)", at revision 1370273105, opens: "The Battle of Roncesvalles took place at the high Roncevaux Pass between French and Anglo-Portuguese forces during the Peninsular War (1808–1814). The French emerged victorious by assaulting this mountain pass." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872203, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle during the Peninsular War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
